Mission Local reported that a 16-year-old boy spent almost three weeks in San Francisco County Jail after being arrested under a different name and initially identified as an adult. The city took 20 days to verify his age, even though officials had been alerted soon after his arrest. He was held apart from adult inmates in C Pod while the city reviewed evidence; a judge ultimately found he was 16 and ordered him transferred to juvenile hall.

The story also reported that the boy’s father had raised his age with courthouse support staff, and that the teenager passed time in C Pod doing crossword puzzles. The DA said the boy had given a false name and birthday.
